function initialize(address deployer, (address token, address patron, address nft, uint256 nftMinBal, uint256 minAmount, uint256 initPrize, uint256 startTime, uint256 endTime, uint32 interval, uint16 betPerc, uint16 refShare, uint16 winnerShare, uint16 nextShare, uint16 patronShare, uint16 teamShare, uint16 holderShare, bool autoFinalize, string uri) setting)
